before-talking-to-captain-pudi-with-leve.npc: Sorry my friend, the Skipper has been grindin' me up the wrong way lately. If ye need anythin', talk t' Cap'ain Pudi over by the dock.

after-talking-to-captain-pudi-with-level.npc: That ungrateful Skipper. How dare he blame me for that freak storm?

options.text: Why are you angry at the Skipper?

steps.player: Why are you angry at the Skipper?

steps.npc: It be a long story.

steps.player: I've got time. I would love to hear it.

steps.npc: Fine, 'ere be me tale of misfortune.
About a half moon ago, we set sail on our fortnightly fishin' trip. 'Twas smooth sailin' all the way t' our spot.
Caught a load of manta ray an' snappers.
Ah, I should'a realised you were a landlubber. We on the ship call them snappers, but you lot call 'em lobsters.
Anyway, back to me tale.
After a couple o' days, we pulled up the anchor an' sailed closer t' the Karamjan coast. There is where the big'ns are.
You landlubbers... It be a shark.

steps.player: Oh, how was I supposed to know?

steps.npc: CAN YOU STOP INTERRUPTIN' ME TALE?
Good, now where was I...
When we arrived at the spot, the Skipper saw a lack of fish swimmin' in the waters.
I looked yonder onto the horizon an' noticed a storm was a brewin', so we adjusted our course accordin'.
As if by magic, winds started a blowin' an' the storm started movin' in our direction.
Lightnin' struck the boat, an' a piece of wood holdin' up the sail fell an' struck me on the 'ead.
I woke up in a bed an' the Skipper started on me, tellin' me I ruined his ship an' I need t' pay him back.

steps.player: That's awful. He does not sound like a nice man.

steps.npc: Nay, he usually is. He be upset about his ship, is all.
Can I help ye with anythin' else?

options.text: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?

steps.player: Got any tips for fighting Tempoross?

steps.npc: Watch out for the waves. If ye get hit by that you could end up lost at sea.
Ye might find tying yourself t' somethin' using a rope t' be a life saver.
Or if ye manage to get yer hands on one of them there fancy Spirity Angler outfits, it comes with a built- in rope harness.
Can I help ye with anythin' else?
Have a good'n. I know I won't.

using-items-on-her-damp-egg.player: Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?

using-items-on-her-damp-egg.npc: Oh, a damp egg! Yes, please!
Aye, I'll add it t' me collection!

using-items-on-her-damp-egg.player: You know there's a crate of them you could just help yourself t'...

using-items-on-her-damp-egg.npc: Hush! Don't let Timallus hear ye speak o' the damp egg crate. It'll set 'im off!

using-items-on-her-damp-egg.text: You give Koanee the damp egg.

using-items-on-her-egg.player: Would you care for an egg in this difficult time?

using-items-on-her-egg.npc: This is some comfort to be sure.
